in_arabic.name: قيسرا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من قيسارية، يعني القوة و الشجاعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قيسرا هو اسم مؤنث مشتق من قيسارية، و تعني القوة و الشجاعة. يعود أصل الاسم إلى اللغة العربية و يستخدم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و قيمة.

in_urdu.name: قیسرا
in_urdu.meaning: قوی اور بہادر، شجاع و مجھول، ایک خوبصورت اسلامی نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: قیسرا نام ایک خوبصورت اور معنوی نام ہے۔ اس کا مطلب قوی اور بہادر، شجاع و مجھول سے ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافتوں میں بڑے احترام کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़ैसरा
in_hindi.meaning: एक सुंदर और शक्तिशाली नाम, साहस और बहादुरी का प्रतीक
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ैसरा एक सुंदर और शक्तिशाली नाम है जो साहस और बहादुरी का प्रतीक है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बड़े सम्मान के साथ उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: قیسره
in_pashto.meaning: پښتو کې د قوي او ځواکمنې نجلې ښکلی او معنوي نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: قیسره یو ښکلی او معنوی نوم دی چې په پښتو کې د قوي او ځواکمنې نجلې ښکارندوی کوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی او د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودونو کې کارول کیږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qaisra is of Arabic origin, and the meaning "one who is like a flower" holds a significant societal and cultural meaning, especially in the Islamic world. Flowers often symbolize beauty, fragility, and resilience in various cultures. In Islamic tradition, flowers represent paradise, joy, and the divine beauty of nature, which is often emphasized in religious texts. Naming a child Qaisra signifies not only the hope that they will flourish and blossom like a beautiful flower but also expresses the belief that they will contribute to the beauty and joy of the world.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Qaisra holds deep significance for Muslims. It is a reminder of the divine cooling shade that one experiences through adherence to the teachings of Allah and His Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). In Islamic tradition, the concept of "Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim" (The Most Merciful, The Compassionate) is emphasized, symbolizing the beauty and compassion of Allah. The name Qaisra encourages one to strive for inner and outer beauty, as well as the spiritual growth and development of one's character and soul. It serves as a reminder that just as a flower blooms and contributes to the beauty of the world, a person's spiritual growth and connection to Allah can also bring joy, peace, and serenity to others.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 8, Page 39 The name Qaisra carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Qaisra bint Khusrau Anushirvan, the sister of the Sassanid king, accompanied her husband, Al-Ala' bin Al-Aqta', to Medina during the migration of the Prophet Muhammad to Medina from Mecca. She embraced Islam and was known as Umm Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith Al-Sulamiyyah.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Ishaq's Sirat Rasul Allah (The Life of Muhammad), Page 221 The name Qaisra carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Qaisra bint Khusrau Anushirvan, the sister of the powerful Sassanid king, came to Medina with her husband Al-Ala' bin Al-Aqta' and her son Al-Qasim during the Battle of Hunayn. She embraced Islam and became known as Umm Al-Fadl bint Al-Harith Al-Sulamiyyah.
